note: Concepts zenodo_deposit.py may extend. closed_concepts and closed_records are the archive through 2.2.0: source 10.5281/zenodo.21443008 and documentation 10.5281/zenodo.21443295, plus every version record in that series. The script never calls new-version on them. spec is one concept per specification number, implementation one concept per library minor. Both start empty. The first deposit of a number creates a concept, and --publish on the production host writes its record and concept ids here. A later patch extends the minor's concept only. A later release of the same spec extends the spec concept only with --corrigendum.
